objective: Produce neutral, equally presented original artifact comparisons from existing R16-R18 unchanged pixels, ask human which design is aesthetically stronger, and separately ask unprimed recognition when feasible.

neutralization.actual_screen_size_caveat: On phones the displayed on-screen size may differ; image files can be opened at native resolution.
neutralization.reveal_protocol: After user submits choices, expose mapping and full evaluation. Do not retroactively change placements.

assessment.user_not_naive: User already saw previous unmasked outputs, so this is METHOD-LABEL MASKING, not strict independently recruited blind human test.

assessment.no_inferred_victory: Must not treat ink count, alpha equality, code or author's opinion as aesthetic pass.
assessment.recommendation_after_votes: Record raw choices first, then unmask, report count with denominator 3 and major statistical limits. No claim of stable aesthetic benefit from 3 correlated and hand-authored examples.
